# airy1-gumbel-lean

> Lean 4 companion to Le Chen and Fei Pu, "Gumbel Fluctuations of the Maximum of the Airy_1 Process" (arXiv:2611.23658v1). It proves that the maximum over [0, T] of a constructed Airy_1 process, centred and scaled as in the paper, converges to the Gumbel law (Theorem 1.1), assuming three named inputs. It does not certify the whole manuscript. Apache-2.0.

Claim boundary (read first):
- Headline: `Airy1Gumbel.gumbel_limit_continuum_real_normalized_airy1_final₂` in Airy1Gumbel/FinalHeadlineTP.lean.
- Its hypotheses: `Airy1FddPositive` (finite-dimensional Airy_1 laws), `GOELeftTail` (cubic one-point left tail), `CubicStrongMixing` (cubic strong mixing). These are assumptions, not theorems.
- The mesoscopic step uses a two-time Fredholm determinant bound, not the paper's association and covariance argument; the paper's Lemma 4.2 and Remark 5.3 are not formalized, and Proposition 4.3 only in the specialisation used in Section 5.2 (along the two-point route).
- Proposition 1.2 (two-term tail expansion over a fixed interval) is proved for the constructed process for every T > 0, under `Airy1FddPositive` and `GOELeftTail`: `Airy1Gumbel.airy1Law_interval_tail_sub_traceLead_isLittleO` in Airy1Gumbel/BlockLawUnconditional.lean (since v0.2.0).
- Lemma 3.1 (two-interval determinant formula) is proved for the constructed process for every equal length T > 0, in the trace-class form (3.3) of Remark 3.2, under `Airy1FddPositive` and `GOELeftTail`: `Airy1Gumbel.airy1Law_two_blocks_le_eq_fredholmDet_of_length` in Airy1Gumbel/TwoIntervalLaw.lean (since v0.3.0). The determinant displayed in (3.1) has no separate Lean definition.
- Lemma 4.1 (block modulus, eq. (4.1)) is proved for the constructed process under `Airy1FddPositive`, `GOELeftTail` and a fourth named input, `NonnegativeWindowModulusEstimate`: the transferred local oscillation bound (4.2) of arXiv:2611.23658v1 on windows inside [0, infinity), which the paper derives from Basu-Bhattacharjee (2024) and which is assumed, not proved, here: `Airy1Gumbel.block_modulus_airy1` in Airy1Gumbel/BlockModulus.lean (since v0.4.0). The headline does not use this input.
- Axioms: `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` only; no `sorry`.
- The correspondence between the Lean statements and the paper was checked by AI-assisted review, not by an independent human referee.

Result numbers are those of the posted arXiv version 1.

## Required context
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/airy1-gumbel-lean/main/README.md): result, inputs, what is not proved, build commands.
- [coverage.yaml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/airy1-gumbel-lean/main/coverage.yaml): the paper-to-Lean map against arXiv 2611.23658v1.
- [claims.yaml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/airy1-gumbel-lean/main/claims.yaml) and [contrib/claims.yaml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/airy1-gumbel-lean/main/contrib/claims.yaml): the named Lean results.
- [Airy1Gumbel/FinalHeadlineTP.lean](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/airy1-gumbel-lean/main/Airy1Gumbel/FinalHeadlineTP.lean): the headline.
- [Airy1Gumbel/ExternalInputs.lean](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/airy1-gumbel-lean/main/Airy1Gumbel/ExternalInputs.lean), [Airy1Gumbel/FddRecord.lean](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/airy1-gumbel-lean/main/Airy1Gumbel/FddRecord.lean), [Airy1Gumbel/GOELeftTail.lean](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/airy1-gumbel-lean/main/Airy1Gumbel/GOELeftTail.lean): the named inputs of the headline.
- [Airy1Gumbel/BlockModulus.lean](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/airy1-gumbel-lean/main/Airy1Gumbel/BlockModulus.lean): Lemma 4.1 and its fourth named input `NonnegativeWindowModulusEstimate` (assumed).

## Gates
- Build: `lake exe cache get && lake build Airy1Gumbel Airy1GumbelContrib`.
- Audit: `lake env lean AxiomCheck.lean > t.txt && python3 scripts/audit.py t.txt` (exact theorem inventory, approved axioms, no proof escapes); the same for contrib/.
- Comparator: [Challenge.lean](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/airy1-gumbel-lean/main/Challenge.lean) (Mathlib-only statements of Theorem 1.1, with the objects defined in ChallengeDefs/Airy1Gumbel/), [Solution.lean](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/airy1-gumbel-lean/main/Solution.lean) (proofs from the package), [comparator.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/airy1-gumbel-lean/main/comparator.json).
- Receipts: verify.sh and contrib/verify.sh, run through lean-pkg; committed under [.lean-receipts/](https://github.com/chenle02/airy1-gumbel-lean/tree/main/.lean-receipts).

## Optional
- [Documentation site](https://chenle02.github.io/airy1-gumbel-lean/)
- [Verification page](https://chenle02.github.io/airy1-gumbel-lean/verification.html) and [coverage page](https://chenle02.github.io/airy1-gumbel-lean/coverage.html), generated by lean-pkg from the receipts and coverage.yaml.
- [contrib/](https://github.com/chenle02/airy1-gumbel-lean/tree/main/contrib): Gumbel law, Airy functions, Mills ratio, Hilbert-Schmidt and trace-class operators, Fredholm determinants, Airy_1 finite-dimensional and two-time estimates.
